standard: Stafford Beer Viable System Model (VSM S1-S5 + S3*)
citation: Stafford Beer, Brain of the Firm (2nd ed., Wiley, 1981) & Diagnosing the System for Organizations (Wiley, 1985); ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023 System Life Cycle Processes

systems.name: Operational Domain Managers
systems.role: Autonomous operational units that implement, render, and verify authoritative domain models as concrete Verdant applications and parts.
invariants: Every shipped route, crate, ObserverPartSlot, stream, template, and authority catalog belongs to an accountable Manager.
Every S1 feature or UI element must bind to an imported authoritative standard; contrived ungrounded features are refused.
Each S1 Manager operates autonomously within its ISO 42010 Viewpoint without leaking executive internals into stakeholder surfaces.

systems.name: Anti-Oscillation Design & Coordination
systems.role: Coordinates shared standards across all S1 units so views never clash, oscillate, or duplicate controls.
invariants: All surfaces share W3C DTCG 2025.10 tokens with zero raw #hex overrides and zero backdrop-filter: blur.
All URLs resolve strictly within the declared subpath base and all packaged archives use exclusive .uorc framing.
Frame-rate scaling obeys hysteresis DRS and FR-03 cold-boot ceilings across every host.

systems.name: Control & Resource Governance
systems.role: Allocates host compute, memory, texture, and cold-boot byte envelopes across operational units.
invariants: HostCapabilityEnvelope bounds GPU texture dimensions, shadow maps, and GLB byte caps to host container limits.
No S1 operational unit may exceed FR-03 cold-boot limits on `/` or introduce external 3D/ML runtimes.

systems.name: Independent Conformance Audit Oracle
systems.role: Directly inspects concrete repository artifacts, live rendered surfaces, and Wasm/Rust invariants bypassing self-report.
invariants: Verifies Total Ownership (zero unmanaged orphan parts across routes, crates, Observer parts, streams, and catalogs).
Verifies every S1 Viewpoint's requiredElements, forbiddenCrossContamination, and differentiationRequirements.

systems.name: Environmental Intelligence & Stream Adaptation
systems.role: Scans external internet streams, authoritative standards, and Operator directives to discover models and standards for S1 Managers.
invariants: Discovers external models and standards through CORS-verified HTTPS streams rather than hand-coding contrived content.
Routes incoming Operator prompts through OMG DMN 1.5 admission and ISO 24617-2 dialogue classification.

systems.name: Observer Executive Policy & Identity
systems.role: Holds Verdant's sovereign Prism identity, mediates S3 stability vs S4 adaptation, and enforces standards-only integrity.
invariants: The Observer encompasses all of Verdant including its Managers and Streams under one cryptographic kappa boundary.
Executive internals never bleed into stakeholder views; all mutations flow through signed Operator communications.

channels.purpose: Policy framing for stream discovery and Operator prompt intake
Identity and budget invariants for operational resource allocation
Adaptation proposals reconciled against host capabilities and stability budgets
Resource grants and signed directives dispatched to accountable S1 Domain Managers
Shared DTCG themes, WCAG 2.2 accessibility, subpath rules, and anti-oscillation standards
Independent direct inspection of S1 surface files, crates, and live behavior
